a: App Router uses the app/ directory with layouts, pages, and server components.
Server Components render on the server and send HTML, reducing client JS.
Client Components use 'use client' for interactivity and browser APIs.
Route Handlers in app/api provide backend endpoints.
SSR renders per request; SSG builds at compile; ISR revalidates periodically.
Middleware runs before requests for auth, redirects, and headers.
next/image optimizes images with sizing, formats, and lazy loading.
NEXT_PUBLIC_ vars are exposed to the browser; others stay server-only.
Common hosts: Vercel, Node servers, or Docker containers.
Export metadata or generateMetadata for SEO titles and Open Graph.
